text:
gina-support: heads-up — acme-corp reporting Dedicated dashboard shows 0 GPUs for their pool after a nodepool migration. ticket SUP-4821. screenshot: https://redwood.link/sup4821.png
cheng-eng-sre: thx gina. cluster name? approx time? any recent label/annotation changes?
gina-support: cluster: acme-dedicated-prod-1. migration window ~2026-03-10T22:11Z. nodepool renamed from `gpu-pool-v1` -> `gpu-pool-g2` via infra script. autoscaler touched annotations. customer says UI rows empty but nodes are healthy.
sara-support: I can reproduce quickly in staging — dashboard shows empty tiles for pools whose nodepool name changed. will add repro steps.
tim-eng-platform: we've seen inventory-service map nodepools by label `redwood/pool` — if name moves to `redwood/pool-name` it's not surfaced. possible mapping key rename bug.
cheng-eng-sre: can you curl the internal inventory API for that cluster? sample command:```curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://inventory.internal/api/v1/clusters/acme-dedicated-prod-1/pools" | jq .```
sara-support: here's the customer output (sanitized):```[{"pool_id":"gpu-pool-g2","gpu_count":0,"display_name":"gpu-pool-v1"}]``` looks like display_name didn't update but pool_id did — UI mixes them and renders empty rows.
deploy-bot: deploy finished: inventory-service v2.14.3 at 2026-03-10T21:05Z (sha: a1b2c3).
tim-eng-platform: that deploy included a heuristic that expected `display_name` to be present; when mismatch occurs we render placeholder row -> 0 GPUs.
cheng-eng-sre: workaround: trigger a full reindex of pool metadata. internal command (ops-only):```POST /internal/sync/reindex?cluster=acme-dedicated-prod-1``` or run the one-off job:```./scripts/sync_pool_metadata --cluster acme-dedicated-prod-1 --force```
sara-support: I ran the reindex in staging and UI repopulated tiles. sending instructions to support runbook.
gina-support: customer notified about temporary workaround. they asked if this can be prevented after future renames.
tim-eng-platform: plan: add tolerant join logic (match by pool_id if display_name mismatch) + alert on metadata drift. I'll open a PR and include a migration to backfill display_name for historical rows.
cheng-eng-sre: ops note — we should add a reconciliation Cron that reconciles nodepool labels -> pool metadata nightly. I'll file a follow-up.
sara-support: adding patch to ticket SUP-4821 with repro, workaround, and ETA for fix.
gina-support: thanks all — I'll keep ticket owner looped and confirm customer follow-up in 2h. :thumbsup:
